rules.statement: An offline-approved credit Pre-Auth must send full track data.
rules.condition: Pre-Auth approved offline; not every online authorization.
rules.quote: If a Pre-Auth transaction is approved offline, the full track data must be sent.

rules.statement: An offline-approved credit Sale must send full track data.
rules.quote: Also if a Sale transaction is approved offline, the full track data must be sent.

rules.statement: After credit partial approval, the POS must prompt for the remaining balance.
rules.condition: Supported partial approval response; amount approved is below the sale balance.
rules.quote: Approved Amount (Element No. 6) contains the approved partial amount, and the POS device must prompt for payment of the remaining balance due on the sale.

rules.statement: After debit partial approval, the POS must prompt for the remaining balance.
rules.quote: Approved Amount (Element No. 6) contains the approved partial amount, and the POS device must prompt for payment of the remaining balance due on the sale.

rules.statement: Any host response to a debit Completion must stop Completion retries.
rules.condition: Debit Completion received an approved or declined response.
rules.quote: Any response from BUYPASS to a Debit Card Completion transaction should end attempts to retry a Debit Card Completion whether "approved" or "declined."

rules.statement: A debit transaction requiring PIN must use DUKPT PIN encryption.
rules.condition: PIN-required debit processing under Section 10.2, not Signature Debit as Credit.
rules.quote: it must be encrypted using the DUKPT PIN encryption method.

rules.statement: A financial transaction requiring fleet data must include Segment 101.
rules.condition: Independently established fleet-data requirement; network ownership alone is not the trigger.
rules.quote: 4–9 101 Fleet Data Segment 308 C Contains fleet-specific data. Sent only on transactions requiring fleet data.

rules.statement: A financial transaction requiring product data must include Segment 102.
rules.quote: 102 Product Code Data Segment 381 C Contains product-specific data. Sent only on transactions requiring product data.

rules.statement: Initial and recurring NFC-tokenized transactions require Segment 123.
rules.condition: Tokenized-data context independently confirmed; does not certify cryptogram or network eligibility.
rules.quote: 123 NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment 186 C Contains data needed to process NFC tokenized transactions. It is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data.

rules.statement: Financial transactions destined for the Moneris authorizer require Segment 135.
rules.quote: 135 Moneris Data (Request) Segment 110 C Contains data required by the Moneris authorizer. It is required only for transactions destined for the Moneris authorizer.

rules.statement: Fields in Segment 100 must be separated by a Field Separator.
rules.quote: All fields are separated by a Field Separator. When a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.

rules.statement: Segment 100 Segment Length must include the Segment Type and Field Separators.
rules.condition: Bounded ASCII Segment 100 serialization; no host acceptance or other field validation.
rules.quote: 2 84 Segment Length 3 R Identifies the data segment’s length, including Segment Type’s length and Field Separators.
